_comment: Copy to palace_sync.config.json and fill in. That file is gitignored: it
describes one pair of machines, not the software.
mirror_dir is where THIS machine keeps the OTHER machine's transcripts.
It is a permanent address. Drawer IDs hash the full absolute source path,
so changing it refiles the entire corpus as duplicate drawers.
pre_mine runs before each mine on that side. macOS needs `ulimit -n 10240`
or chroma dies mid-mine with 'Too many open files' (its default is 256).
